why: A September 2025 paper (Lucke et al., 'Large cardinals, structural reflection, and the HOD Conjecture' / 'Large cardinals beyond HOD') introduces exacting and ultraexacting cardinals and shows they are strong enough to refute the Weak HOD Conjecture and Weak Ultimate-L Conjecture, bearing on whether a core model containing all large cardinals (Ultimate-L) can exist; unclear whether this counts as moving the stated problem itself or is about the related, more specific Ultimate-L/Weak Ultimate-L Conjectures rather than the general 'ultimate core model' problem.
